# Am I Getting Rorted?

> Australian NBN and Opticomm home internet plan comparison. Every plan from every
> provider at each speed tier, ranked purely by price, refreshed daily. Tells you
> whether the price you pay is fair using the "Rort Scale".

Prices are AUD per month. Data comes from NetBargains plus community-scraped
providers. Rankings are never influenced by advertising or affiliate deals.

## Pages

- [Home](https://amigettingrorted.au/): plan checker and all speed tiers
- [How the rating works](https://amigettingrorted.au/how-it-works): Rort Scale thresholds, promo maths, commitment periods
- [Submit a missing plan](https://amigettingrorted.au/submit)
- [Every provider](https://amigettingrorted.au/providers): per-provider pages at /provider/<slug> with plans, tier ranks, Rort Scale and price history
- [Monthly price reports](https://amigettingrorted.au/reports): /reports/YYYY-MM with every price rise and drop; RSS at /reports/feed.xml
- [Sitemap](https://amigettingrorted.au/sitemap.xml): every tier page, e.g. /nbn-100-20, /opticomm-500-50, /nbn-100 (grouped)

## For AI agents

- MCP server (Streamable HTTP, no auth): https://ismynbncooked-mcp.venksriram.workers.dev/mcp
- Tools: list_tiers, get_plans, find_cheapest, rate_plan, get_price_history, get_provider_plans
- Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport http amigettingrorted https://ismynbncooked-mcp.venksriram.workers.dev/mcp`
